DATE/TIME
Deck-list submission cut-off time: (Saturday) 25th of January 2025 at 9:00AM
Tournament Check-In: (Saturday) 25th of January 2025 at 10:00AM
Tournament Check-In and payment cutoff time: 10:45AM
1st Round Begins at 11:00 AM
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOCATION
Back to Games
Town Center Jumeirah - Ground Floor - Jumeirah 1
Dubai - United Arab Emirates
All players are expected to adhere to store rules and code of conduct while visiting and participating in activities within the store.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
REGISTRATION
Registration Fee: 100AED

Participation rewards are:
1x Mortal Ambition Regional Championship Binder
1x Sapphire pack
1x Proxia's Vault Pack
2x Mortal Ambition Event Packs
2 x Mortal Ambition Booster Packs

To view what the regionals participation prizes are please have a look at this link: https://www.gatcg.com/article/mortal-ambition-regionals
There is a Registration limit of 40 players so we recommend registering as soon as possible to guarantee your spot
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRIZES

If we reach a total of 40 registrations there will be 16 Booster Boxes Allocated to prizing with 1st place receiving 4 Booster Boxes as their winnings. The remainder of the prizes will be distributed to Top 16. 
If there are less than 40 participants then the prize pool and distribution will be adjusted accordingly.

Top 8 Will receive a Backup Charger Nationals Wildcard Invite Card
Top 8 will receive Regionals Finalists Playmats
First place will receive a Regionals Champion Playmat
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you have any further questions feel free to message me (Arash - +971-50-3603280) on WhatsApp Directly.

Also there's a huge active WhatsApp community who'll be glad to assist with any questions you might have!
WhatsApp Community Invite Link: https://bit.ly/gauae

Good luck! ❤️
